content: P0: Full forensic of FOMO-DATA + FOMO-12, capability map (NEWS1_FORENSIC.md)

Phase 1 (backbone): NewsSource registry (121 seeded) + NewsFetcher (rss-parser) + NewsParserRun + multi-layer dedupe + write news_articles + import→News + Bull staggered scheduler + fetch safety/retry/circuit-breaker + admin endpoints
Phase 1 verify: real RSS news end-to-end → news_articles(706) → News(122) → website Buzz→News EN (verified via API+DB+screenshot)
Phase 2: CRM News Control Center under Контент→Новости (RU, our design): Обзор/Источники/Парсинг/Запуски/Статистика/Диагностика + Health
Phase 3: Clustering + provenance + AI synthesis via FomoAiGateway (classify/cluster/synthesis/translate) → GeneratedNews → News (EN); AI-генерация tab; COGS; AI failure isolation + retry
Phase 4: Moderation (green/yellow/red publication trust) + publish lifecycle + website detail/comments + regression of Buzz/Topics/Calendar
Phase 5: Full Update pipeline + calendar linkage + audit + permissions + bootstrap idempotency + final runtime acceptance
